description: A digital representation of a traditional 'Khata' (account book) for Sanjeev Mill Udhyog. Combines the trustworthy, formal feeling of old-world accounting (parchment paper, maroon leather bindings, brass accents) with the efficiency of a modern high-density financial dashboard. The goal is an elite, highly readable, non-generic business tool with an 'Old Money / Heritage' aesthetic.

primary_heading.usage: H1, H2, Company Name, Print Header

monospace_data.usage: All numerical data, currency amounts (Rs.), rates, quantities, and dates. Ensures tabular alignment.

body_ui.usage: Buttons, form labels, small text, table headers.

layout_and_spacing.container: Use max-w-7xl mx-auto with substantial padding (p-6 or p-8) to represent the physical 'page'.
layout_and_spacing.ledger_lines: Instead of generic rounded floating cards, use strong vertical and horizontal dividers (border-b, border-r) to mimic ruled paper.
layout_and_spacing.the_binding: Add a thick left border (e.g., border-l-8 border-[#7B1E27]) to the main app layout or critical customer detail panels to mimic the red spine of a Khata book.
layout_and_spacing.density: Tight padding (p-3 to p-4) in ledger rows to fit maximum data comfortably on a single screen without scrolling.
layout_and_spacing.corners: Minimal border radius. Use rounded-sm or 0px. No pill-shaped floating elements for main containers. Keep it sharp and formal.

components.buttons: Rectangular, sharp corners. Primary buttons should be #7B1E27 background with white text. Hover state: slightly darker, NO shadow. Keep it flat.
components.tables: Crucial component. Must have clearly defined horizontal borders. The 'Running Balance' column must be distinctly highlighted (perhaps a light #FDFBF7 background or bold monospace text).
components.forms: Inputs should have sharp borders (border-[#E2D9C8]), #FDFBF7 background inside the input field, and monospace text for amount inputs.
components.badges: For 'Due' vs 'Paid'. Square or slightly rounded. Minimal padding.
components.print_view: Must strip all navigation, sidebars, and UI backgrounds. Black and white mostly, with the #7B1E27 maroon used only for the company header and the final balance. Strictly structured for A4 portrait printing.

images.description: Vintage antique leather bound book texture for the login screen background.
Sample customer profile picture for the ledger dashboard.

motion.philosophy: Functional and understated. No bouncy animations.
motion.interactions: Hover states on ledger rows (slight background darkening to #F9F6F0). Quick, snappy transitions (duration-150 ease-in-out).

accessibility.contrast: Ensure the text_secondary (#5C544D) meets APCA standards against the parchment background. Ensure red/green statuses are distinguishable by lightness, not just hue.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.

instructions_to_main_agent: Inject standard Tailwind classes using the custom color hexes provided. You may need to extend tailwind config with these exact hex codes.
Import 'Playfair Display', 'Space Mono', and 'Inter' from Google Fonts in the global CSS or index.html.
Construct the dashboard focusing on data density. The 'Ledger' view is the most critical: Date, Product, Qty, Rate, Total, Payment In, Running Balance.
Create a specific CSS print media query (@media print) to hide the sidebar, navbar, and action buttons for the 'Print Ledger' feature.
Use Phosphor icons or Lucide icons for a refined, professional look. DO NOT use emojis as icons.
Avoid standard Shadcn 'Card' wrappers if they add too much shadow/radius. Override them to have 0px radius and solid 1px borders to mimic physical paper.
DO NOT use complete `transparent` background in header, overlays, any surface that has content under it.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Prioritize pre-existing components from src/components/ui, but override their generic SaaS look to match this 'Khata' aesthetic.
Ensure dark colors are used solidly, NO gradients.
Do NOT center align the app container. Maintain a left-aligned, document-like reading flow.
All money amounts MUST use the monospace font.
